about: REE-265 step 0: the ceilings of the work one answer may make, per state (tools/answercost.js, tests/answercost.test.js), for a player in the middle of a session (the page's clock 30 s after the state's last answer), signed out. Each is the largest count measured over the page's seeds 1 to 3 (the same state and seed give counts that differ by up to 15% from run to run, the seeds by up to 50% on fish:3000), times the margin, rounded up to two significant digits, at least 100 calls: first on main after #1522 (with one regeneration of the state), then after the units in play became a view of the state version (REE-265 step 3: fn:bonusCalc, the units in play computed, in place of fn:bonusList), and after the tree's score and the levels became views (REE-265 step 4: fn:lvStepCalc, a unit's level computed, in place of fn:lvStep); a ceiling a step does not lower and its runs would raise keeps its value while every run stays under it (fish:500 setChars, noise; step 4: getChars and the corals' getCalls, the stored texts stateNow compares at each read of a view). A step that lowers a count tightens its ceilings in the same PR: node tools/answercost.js --write-budget tools/answercost-budget.json --margin 1.25 --also <the --out files of the other seeds>.
